documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software reported consolidated revenues of 76.7 billion for financial year 2025-26, representing a 12% increase year-on-year, while net income rose 11% to 26.4 billion. Management highlighted advancements in artificial intelligence and cloud computing, expanding the cloud services portfolio for the banking industry, and maintaining strong operational efficiency and financial discipline. The Board approved two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for the fiscal year. Additionally, the company was recognized as a market leader by several industry analysts including IDC MarketScape, Chartis, and Celent. Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of ₹68.5 billion for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, reflecting a 7% increase over the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends during the financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced an increasing demand for its cloud-native banking solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Driven by an increasing demand for our cloud-native banking solutions, our License & Cloud revenues grew 13% over financial year 2023-24.

demand_outlook.claim: Banks are facing intense pressure to deliver digital delight at scale while maintaining complete regulatory compliance at the lowest possible cost.
demand_outlook.quote: With an increasingly tech savvy customer base which is spoilt for choice, banks are under intense pressure to deliver “digital delight” at scale with complete compliance to regulations and at the lowest possible cost.

demand_outlook.claim: Financial institutions are increasingly looking at solutions delivered on a new architecture that is adaptable to rapid change and available on the cloud.
demand_outlook.quote: Banks are increasingly looking at solutions delivered on a new architecture which is adaptable to rapid change and is available on the cloud.

capex_expansion.claim: The company significantly expanded its cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of several new cloud services.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we significantly expanded our cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of Oracle Banking Retail Lending Servicing Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Collections Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Cash Management Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Supply Chain Management Cloud Service, and Oracle Banking Trade Finance Cloud Service.

margins_costs.claim: The net margin remained strong at 34% for the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Net income rose to ₹ 26.4 billion, reflecting an 11% increase year-on-year, while the net margin remained strong at 34%.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained strong financial discipline resulting in an operating margin of 44%.
margins_costs.quote: We also continued to maintain strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%, reflecting the Company's consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained strong financial discipline while driving growth, resulting in an operating margin of 44% for the financial year compared to 42% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: We continued to maintain a strong financial discipline while driving the growth, and our operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% as compared to 42% in the last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The net margin for the financial year was reported at 35%.
margins_costs.quote: The net income for the financial year was ₹ 23.8 billion, a 7% increase, and the net margin was 35%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed multiple multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers worldwide during the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world which are a testimony to the excellence of our products through continuing R&D, our track record of delivering high quality implementations, and providing reliable support.

orders_capacity.claim: Leading global banks launched programs to revamp their global payment technologies across over 50 countries on the company's IT solutions.
orders_capacity.quote: Leading global banks launched programs to revamp their global payment technologies across over 50 countries on our IT solutions.

orders_capacity.claim: The company won a landmark deal with The Navy Federal Credit Union, USA to modernize their retail systems on the Oracle Banking Cloud offering.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company won a landmark deal with The Navy Federal Credit Union, USA to modernize their retail systems on our Oracle Banking Cloud offering.

orders_capacity.claim: Fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M, representing the highest ever for the company and a 44% growth over the last fiscal year.
orders_capacity.quote: The fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M – highest ever for the Company, registering a 44% growth over last fiscal.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a first interim dividend of 130 per equity share and a second interim dividend of 270 per equity share of 5 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company ("the Board") declared 1st interim dividend of ₹ 130 per equity share and 2nd interim dividend of ₹ 270 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on October 17, 2025 and April 22, 2026, respectively, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved an interim dividend of ₹265 per share for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board was pleased to approve an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the last financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: On the strength of the financial performance, the Board declared an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per share for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: On the strength of the performance, the Board was pleased to declare an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per share for the financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends led to demand challenges in the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts and economic slowdowns.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, highly visible failures of some banks in the western world, and tectonic technology shifts with increasing usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and machine learning (ML).

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a commitment to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation, and maintaining the highest standards of governance.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation and maintaining the highest standards of governance.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
